historicalNote.text: A bare rocky hill, 3,022 feet high, in the northeast of Chitaldroog District, Mysore, The Kadambas had a fort here called Lunkeya-kote.

Hill in the Molakalmuru taluk of Chitaldroog District, Mysore, Here, in 1892, were discovered Asoka edicts engraved on a great boulder. Isila, to the authorities of which they are addressed, may be the ‘ Sidda- ^ of Siddapura, the village close by on the west.
